contentBlocks.body: keyof creates a union of an object's property names. It is useful when a helper accepts a key and you want TypeScript to prevent misspelled or impossible property names.

knowledgeItems.prompt: For `type User = { id: string; name: string }`, what is `keyof User`?

payload.explanation: keyof produces a union of known property names.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return the value at the requested property key.

payload.text: In getProperty<T, K extends keyof T>, the return type ____ is the type of the property named by K.
